title: Neurobiology Evidence Grade — Human, Animal, Mechanistic and Speculative Layers
purpose: Prevent the project from flattening stable anatomy, human observations, animal causal work, active research fields and Potatoverse analogy into one confidence level.

grade_scale.meaning: well-established anatomy/physiology supported across human and experimental evidence
strong evidence with meaningful human support, but mechanism/detail remains actively refined
credible emerging field; substantial experimental evidence but important human translation/causal questions remain
limited/preliminary direct evidence or strongly model-dependent claim
Potatoverse/project interpretation, historical/esoteric comparison or hypothesis; not scientific evidence

topics.topic: basic thalamic anatomy and reciprocal thalamocortical organization
topics.basis: Human anatomy, lesions, electrophysiology/imaging and extensive animal systems neuroscience.
topics.boundary: Specific nuclei have heterogeneous functions; avoid one-relay-switch language.

topics.basis: Large heterogeneous human and animal literature links several thalamic nuclei, especially intralaminar/CM-Pf systems, with arousal and consciousness state; agreement on a unique consciousness nucleus is lacking.
topics.boundary: Supports importance, not a sole seat/seed of consciousness.

topics.basis: Well-established neuroendocrine physiology: retinal light entrains SCN-driven autonomic influence on pineal melatonin rhythms.
topics.boundary: Does not support literal Third Eye or spiritual-light claims.

topics.basis: Direct human ventricular measurements in small clinical samples report higher third-ventricular melatonin and support possible entry through the pineal recess; animal evidence is stronger. Physiological significance remains unresolved.
topics.boundary: Do not generalize to pineal CSF sensing, consciousness or mystical present-time detection.

topics.basis: Strong anatomy/physiology across visceral sensory receptors, vagal/spinal afferents, brainstem circuits and forebrain integration, with convergent human and animal evidence.
topics.boundary: Exact coding of complex subjective feeling remains incomplete; interoception is not one pathway or organ.

topics.topic: baroreflex, chemoreflex and brainstem cardiorespiratory control
topics.basis: Established cardiovascular/respiratory physiology with human clinical and experimental support.
topics.boundary: Does not imply a separate heart consciousness or spiritual breath force.

topics.basis: Multiple pathways are well established, including enteric, vagal, endocrine, immune and metabolic signaling; human causal translation varies by mechanism and condition.
topics.boundary: Avoid deterministic microbiome→mood/personality claims and direct gut-neurotransmitter→brain simplifications.

topics.basis: Associations and plausible pathways are abundant, but causative, correlative and bidirectional contributions differ by phenotype and remain difficult to separate in humans.
topics.boundary: Do not translate rodent transfer studies into universal human psychological causation.

topics.basis: Specific epithelial–neural synaptic pathways have strong experimental support; scope and relative importance across human gut physiology remain active research.
topics.boundary: Do not generalize one neuropod circuit to all microbiome/gut signaling.

topics.topic: choroid plexus as CSF-producing blood–CSF barrier and immune interface
topics.basis: Established anatomy/physiology; molecular transport and immune roles continue to be refined.
topics.boundary: Selective interface, not sacred purifier or passive filter.

topics.basis: Anatomical and functional evidence across animals with growing human imaging/anatomical support.
topics.boundary: Exact quantitative contribution to brain-solute clearance in normal humans remains under study.

topics.basis: Strong animal tracer literature and growing human MRI/tracer observations, but interpretation of routes, mechanisms and coupling to lymphatic drainage remains debated.
topics.boundary: Do not present one canonical glymphatic pipe model as settled human anatomy or spiritual cleansing.

topics.basis: Physical channels exist in humans and experimental work supports immune-cell/solute exchange, but most functional mechanistic evidence is rodent-based and disease-context heavy.
topics.boundary: Do not describe normal human skull marrow as a proven rapid CSF-immune command system.

topics.topic: neuroimmune connectome and vagal inflammatory circuits
topics.basis: Nervous–immune bidirectional communication is established; specific circuit logic is rapidly developing with strong animal causal work and selected human/clinical evidence.
topics.boundary: The vagus is not a universal anti-inflammatory healing cable and immune state is not spiritual purity.

topics.basis: Renal sympathetic efferent physiology is established; sensory afferent contributions to sympathetic regulation have substantial experimental and growing clinical relevance.
topics.boundary: Does not imply kidney consciousness.

topics.basis: Sympathetic regulation is well established; sensory adipose innervation is anatomically supported but its normal integrative roles are less resolved and heavily experimental.
topics.boundary: Do not overstate fat-to-brain sensory coding in humans.

topics.topic: muscle-derived myokines as mediators of exercise→brain effects
topics.basis: Exercise benefits and muscle secretory activity are established, but relative causal contribution, source specificity and BBB actions of individual proposed myokines remain incompletely resolved, with much mechanistic work preclinical.
topics.boundary: Do not label one myokine the molecule of exercise, cognition or spiritual vitality.

topics.basis: Core hypothalamic–pituitary–gonadal physiology and GnRH/gonadotropin/steroid feedback are well established; detailed neural regulation continues to develop.
topics.boundary: Biological sexual differentiation does not establish metaphysical polarity or spiritual hierarchy.

topics.basis: Repository formalization integrating several independently established biological channels; River is the project-level unifying analogy, not a scientific entity.
topics.boundary: Never cite the existence of many body flows as evidence for Spirit or one universal information fluid.

topics.basis: Systems/control analogy built from genuine biological feedback loops.
topics.boundary: No single anatomical center or universal control law has been demonstrated.

project_rule: When a claim crosses from grade A/B biology into C/D active research or P project interpretation, the change in evidence status must be explicit in the same record. Never use a P-level Potatoverse mapping to raise the scientific grade of a biological claim.
